rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; discovery dataset from DIDA-MDD (9 research sites), validation dataset from REST-meta-MDD consortium (25 research sites). Two separate normative models built independently within each multi-site dataset.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The DIDA-MDD encompassed nine research sites (Sun et al., 2023)." / "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites"

rci2_using_epd.detail: The validation dataset normative model uses HCs from the REST-meta-MDD consortium, which is an EPD. The discovery dataset uses DIDA-MDD (not in EPD list; in-house consortium).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium used for the validation dataset normative model. DIDA-MDD (discovery dataset) is not in the EPD list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019)"

rci5_n.detail: Overall HC sample for each dataset; all HCs used to train Gaussian process regression normative model within each dataset independently. No train/test split of HCs reported for the final model.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "the final sample included 1148 patients with MDD ... and 1079 HCs" / "comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD ... and 1104 HCs"
rci5_n.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L77-L85; S0033291724002617sup001.docx.md: Table S1

rci6_sex.detail: Overall HC sample; model-1 sex counts from Table S1 (613+466=1079, matches N). Model-2 sex counts from Table S1 (641+462=1103, 1 short of N=1104; possible 1 HC with missing sex data). Percentages computed using total N as denominator.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "1079 HCs (age: 33.96 ± 19.25 years, females: 56.81%)" / "1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%)" / Table S1: HC Sex (female/male): 613/466 (discovery), 641/462 (validation)
rci6_sex.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L77-L85; S0033291724002617sup001.docx.md: Table S1

rci7_age.detail: Overall HC sample; age in years. Model-1 SD=13.87 from Table S1 (header: 'Age, mean (SD), y'); paper body text reports SD as 19.25 — discrepancy unresolved. Model-2 SD reported as NR because Table S1 shows 245.52 (apparent decimal-shift error) and paper body text reports 24.552 (unusually high for age SD); neither value is reliable. Min/max age not reported for HCs in either dataset.
